results.name: Barbell Seated Good Morning
instructions: Sit parallel on a bench with your feet flat on the floor. Hold a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at your hips and lean your torso forward, lowering it towards your thighs while keeping your back straight.
Lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor, while keeping your back straight and your elbows slightly bent.
Lift your torso back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on hinging at the hips rather than bending at the waist to properly target the lower back and hamstrings.
Control the descent and ascent of your torso to maximize muscle engagement and prevent strain.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lower your torso and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Barbell Seated Good Morning is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Glutes, Adductors.

results.name: Barbell Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell with both hands using an overhand grip (palms facing down). Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Shift your weight to your right leg and lift your left leg behind you, keeping it straight. Allow the barbell to hang down, keeping your arms straight naturally.
Lower the barbell until your torso is almost parallel to the floor and your left leg is extended behind you in a straight line. Keep your right knee slightly bent.
Lift your torso back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
tips: Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Focus on balance by keeping your supporting leg steady and your movements controlled.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lower the barbell and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Barbell Single Leg Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Snatch Deadlift Close Grip
instructions: Start in a squat position with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward. Hold the barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing down), hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. The barbell should be on the floor, close to your shins.
Lift the barbell off the floor by extending your hips and knees simultaneously, keeping the barbell close to your body.
Continue lifting until you are standing upright with the barbell at hip level.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control, bending your hips and knees. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders to ensure proper form.
Keep the barbell close to your body throughout the lift to maximize efficiency and control.
Focus on smooth, controlled movements to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
results.description: Barbell Snatch Deadlift Close Grip is an advanced multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Upper Back.

results.name: Barbell Snatch Deadlift Wide Grip
instructions: Start in a squat position with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward. Hold the barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing down), hands placed about 2 fists wider than shoulder-width apart. The barbell should be on the floor, close to your shins.
Lift the barbell off the floor by extending your hips and knees simultaneously, keeping the barbell close to your body.
Continue lifting until you are standing upright with the barbell at hip level.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control, bending your hips and knees. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders to ensure proper form.
Keep the barbell close to your body throughout the lift to maximize efficiency and control.
Focus on smooth, controlled movements to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
results.description: Barbell Snatch Deadlift Wide Grip is an advanced multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Upper Back.

results.name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward. Position a barbell on the floor in front of you, and squat down to grip the barbell with both hands inside your legs, using an overhand grip (palms facing down).
Drive through your heels and extend your hips and knees simultaneously to lift the barbell off the floor. Keep the barbell close to your body and your arms straight as you stand up.

Once you reach the top position, squeeze your glutes and stand tall. Slowly lower the barbell back to the floor by bending at the hips and knees, maintaining a straight back. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement to avoid rounding your spine.
Drive through your heels to lift the barbell and engage your glutes and hamstrings.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift the barbell and inhaling as you lower it back down.
results.description: Barbell Sumo Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Supinated Pendlay Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an underhand gip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Bend at the hips and knees to lower your torso until it is parallel to the floor.
Begin the row by pulling the barbell towards your abdomen, driving your elbows up and back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement, ensuring the barbell lightly touches your abdomen.
Lower the barbell back to the floor with control, fully extending your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back flat and avoid rounding your shoulders to ensure proper form.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement to maximize back muscle activation.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
Exhale as you pull the barbell upward and inhale as you lower it back to the floor.
results.description: Barbell Supinated Pendlay Row is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the upper back (back). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Forearms.

results.name: Barbell Underhand Bent Over Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an underhand grip (palms facing up), hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.

Slightly bend your knees and hinge at your hips, keeping your back straight and torso slightly above parallel to the floor. Allow the barbell to hang directly in front of you with your arms fully extended.
Pull the barbell toward your lower ribcage by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position by extending your arms fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight throughout the movement to avoid rounding your spine.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement to maximize muscle engagement.
Keep your elbows close to your body throughout the movement to effectively target your back muscles.
results.description: Barbell Underhand Bent Over Row is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Upper Back.

results.name: Barbell Upright Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing down), hands placed shoulder-width apart. Allow the barbell to rest against your thighs with your arms fully extended.
Pull the barbell upward along the front of your body by bending your elbows and lifting your upper arms.
Continue lifting the barbell until it reaches chest height, keeping your elbows higher than your wrists throughout the movement.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position by extending your arms fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Lead with your elbows to ensure proper muscle engagement and avoid wrist strain.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift the barbell and inhaling as you lower it back down.
Avoid using momentum or swinging your body to lift the barbell.
results.description: Barbell Upright Row is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Biceps.

results.name: Barbell Wide Grip Upright Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing down), hands placed wider than shoulder-width apart. Allow the barbell to rest against your thighs with your arms fully extended.
Pull the barbell upward along the front of your body by bending your elbows and lifting your upper arms.
Continue lifting the barbell until it reaches chest height, keeping your elbows higher than your wrists throughout the movement.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position by extending your arms fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement to avoid leaning forward.
Lead with your elbows to ensure proper muscle engagement and avoid wrist strain.
Avoid using momentum or swinging your body to lift the barbell.
results.description: Barbell Wide Grip Upright Row is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Behind Neck Lat Pull Down Machine
instructions: Sit at a lat pulldown machine with your feet flat on the floor. Grasp the bar with a wide overhand grip (palms facing forward).
Lean slightly forward and pull the bar down behind your neck, keeping your elbows pointed down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together as you bring the bar down to the back of your neck.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position, extending your arms fully without locking your elbows. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a slight forward lean to avoid excessive neck strain.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you pull the bar down and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Ensure the knee pad is securely positioned to prevent your legs from lifting during the movement.
results.description: Behind Neck Lat Pull Down Machine is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Upper Back.
